verification.initialRecordDocumentationFailure: Record command examples used a local proxy prefix; normalized to portable commands, then rerun.

reviewRedPhase.scope: four modes x both endpoints: expired-session retry and completion, plus missing reply context

limitations: Simulated authenticated context, not IPC signature authorization.
Exact size applies to the explicit fixed fixture layout; actual signed lengths are compared.
No source dispatch, live cancellation or freshness witness.
Structural work/serialized state limits are not CPU or heap performance evidence.
No S_ref bridge, native isolation, workload performance or original read skipping.
The workload limits describe this comparison only; a larger inventory is refused before any read, not supported.
Outcome recording after a session ends is a fixture call, not a native termination witness.

reviewFixes.sessionDeadline: begin and lease transitions compare current session deadline with retained original deadline; retries never refill counters
reviewFixes.completeReply: strict snapshot, inventoryDigest, transferId, requestDigest, planDigest and exact parts; authority-pinned inventory and expected public-key signature validation
reviewFixes.negativeCases: re-signed missing, swapped and extra response fields, altered parts, wrong signing key and oversized reply

reviewFixes2.sessionEnd: unknown, ended and retire no longer need a live session; the deadline is fixed in the lease; only complete needs current authorization
reviewFixes2.rangeAuthorization: a range command needs a verified plan handle replanned from verified inventory; estimate results cannot begin or accept a reply
reviewFixes2.noPartialResult: i0ReceiveTransfer returns entries only after every reply and entry digest match
reviewFixes2.slotDerivation: operations per read and slots are derived from the workload limits and checked at bootstrap

mutation.equivalent: reply total bytes: the same result follows from part length and range total checks
mutation.method: manual script in a throwaway copy; not repeatable from the repository
